newsitem.title: UK: Kellogg Europe consolidates media buying with JWT.
newsitem.headline: Kellogg Europe consolidates media buying with JWT.

text.p: Kellogg Europe announced on Wednesday it was consolidating its media buying into a newly formed company that is part of J. Walter Thompson.

Kellogg Europe, part of U.S.-based Kellogg Co, the world's largest cereal maker, previously bought its advertising space through six different companies but will now use just one company called Kellogg Europe Media.
"Consolidating all European media buying will facilitate more effective communication across our European operations, said Donald G Fritz, president Kellogg Europe.
Kellogg Media Europe will be a wholly owned subsidiary of J.Walter Thompson, which is owned by WPP Group Plc. It will handle all Kellogg Europe's media negotiations beginning in 1998.
Media buyers purchase TV and radio airtime and advertising space in newspapers, magazines and on poster sites on behalf of their clients.
